name: fitness-design-check
title_zh: 跑起 Blazor 逐屏比对设计稿的 UI 验收员
tagline_zh: 设计稿说按钮该是 8px 圆角，代码里写着 6px——肉眼看不出来，它跑起真应用逐屏量。响应式断点。
tagline_en: Your design says 8px radius, the code says 6px — invisible to the eye. It boots the real app, measures screen by.
desc_en: Verify a FitnessApp UI implementation against current design evidence and the running Blazor application. Use for visual fidelity, responsive behavior, interaction-state, and accessibility checks. Do not use for general feature implementation, code review, or pull-request preparation.
why_zh: 不读代码猜样式，而是启动真实 Blazor 应用抓当前渲染结果，再和设计证据逐项对。
why_en: It doesn't guess styles from source — it launches the real Blazor app, captures what actually renders, and matches it item by.
limit_zh: 只做视觉保真、响应式、交互态和无障碍这四类验收；功能实现、代码审查、PR 准备一律不管。
limit_en: Covers only visual fidelity, responsive, interaction-state and a11y checks — no feature work, code review or PR prep. Needs a runnable Blazor app.
title_en: UI verifier that runs your Blazor app and diffs it against.
